paragraphs.text: The Patron of the Nezumi is a kami from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War . It is the great Patron Kami of the Nezumi .

The kami's appearance is that of a giant black beast, vaguely rat-shaped with gnarly skin, forearms ending in spikes, and a long tail. Its face is dominated by its giant mouth filled with jagged teeth, and smoke-trailing vessels float around its head. It is known to eat Nezumi as offerings.
